mapper.insert: insert into product_metric_daily (metric_date, product_id, view_count, cart_add_count, paid_order_count, paid_quantity, paid_amount, create_time, update_time) values (#{metricDate}, #{productId}, #{viewCount}, #{cartAddCount}, #{paidOrderCount}, #{paidQuantity}, #{paidAmount}, now(), now()) on duplicate key update view_count = view_count + values (view_count), cart_add_count = cart_add_count + values (cart_add_count), paid_order_count = paid_order_count + values (paid_order_count), paid_quantity = paid_quantity + values (paid_quantity), paid_amount = paid_amount + values (paid_amount), update_time = now()
mapper.select: select ifnull(sum(view_count), 0) as viewCount, ifnull(sum(cart_add_count), 0) as cartAddCount, ifnull(sum(paid_order_count), 0) as paidOrderCount, ifnull(sum(paid_quantity), 0) as paidQuantity, ifnull(sum(paid_amount), 0) as paidAmount from product_metric_daily where metric_date >= #{dateFrom}

select metric_date as metricDate, ifnull(sum(view_count), 0) as viewCount, ifnull(sum(cart_add_count), 0) as cartAddCount, ifnull(sum(paid_order_count), 0) as paidOrderCount, ifnull(sum(paid_quantity), 0) as paidQuantity, ifnull(sum(paid_amount), 0) as paidAmount from product_metric_daily group by metric_date order by metric_date desc limit #{limit}
